text:
taylor (docs): Hey team — opened a docs PR for the release notes & changelog: model catalog deprecations + migration guide. Need review and approvals before Friday release. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/248

sam (eng): Looking now. is this also blocking the SDK snippet for model fallback?

taylor (docs): Yes — added JS/py snippets under 'migration' section. main thing is accuracy of code and that the examples use the new endpoint param `model_variant`.

priya (product): Quick ask — release notes should mention 2 deprecations (gpt-lite-v1, rerank-legacy) and the recommended mapping. Draft blurb: 'Deprecating gpt-lite-v1 and rerank-legacy. Use gpt-lite-v2@quant or rerank-2025 for improved latency and scoring. See migration notes.' Thoughts?

miguel (ml): +1 on wording. Suggest we add a small note about potential tokenization differences for gpt-lite-v2 quantized builds.

sam (eng): CI/docs preview failed — broken internal link to /models/gpt-lite. Error: 404 in rendered site. Looks like model slug changed to gpt-lite-v1 (we referenced old slug).

taylor (docs): I'll patch link. Quick fix: change /models/gpt-lite -> /models/gpt-lite-v1. Pushing commit in a minute.

taylor (docs): pushed commit 6f2a3. @sam please re-run preview.

ci-bot: docs build started for PR #248...

ci-bot: docs preview failed — markdown linter: trailing whitespace in docs/release-notes.md: line 34.

taylor (docs): fixing linter; removing trailing space and reformatting list. Also added migration snippet: code block showing header. Snippet: ```js
await client.generate({model: 'gpt-lite-v2', model_variant: 'quant', prompt: '...'})
```

sam (eng): looks good. Re-run passed. preview: https://deploy-preview-248--docs.redwood.ai/release-notes/2026-03-21

priya (product): small edit to release blurb: change 'recommended mapping' to 'recommended replacements' and note SLA differences. I pushed suggestion directly to PR.

taylor (docs): accepted suggestion and squashed. Ready for reviewers. Who can approve? @sam for correctness, @miguel for migration note, @priya for product wording.

sam (eng): approving now. Left one nit: the SDK snippet uses client.generate but our JS SDK now uses client.text.generate v2, can you align?

taylor (docs): good catch — updated snippet to use client.text.generate. pushed 9a8b1.

miguel (ml): LGTM for migration section. Approving.

priya (product): approved. Also add a line in changelog: 'Models deprecated: gpt-lite-v1 (sunset 2026-04-15), rerank-legacy (sunset 2026-05-01) — see migration guide.'

taylor (docs): added changelog line and date tags. CI green.

ci-bot: all checks passed for PR #248 — docs build ok, spellcheck ok.

sam (eng): merging this before end-of-day to get into Friday release. @taylor please squash-merge when ready.

taylor (docs): squashed and merged PR #248. changelog updated. :tada:

priya (product): thanks all. will include in release notes email.

miguel (ml): quick note — let's monitor evals for quant migration; I have a smoke test scheduled.

taylor (docs): thread closed. I'll follow up if any post-merge link redirects needed.
